name: video-analysis
description: Analyze a video with Sonilo and get back a creative brief for its sound, derived from the footage itself — by default both a music-direction brief (a time-aligned section plan plus one or more ready-to-use generation prompts) and a sound-design brief (shot-sized SFX segments plus one whole-clip SFX prompt); `mode` picks just one.
